1.say: Hold the blue standing rope upright with one hand. Cross the blue tail across the front of the standing rope. Leave a round loop hanging below.
placements: blue rope tail → across front of blue standing part to form one open round lower loop below the cross; in the video: tail points left horizontal and loop hangs lower right with tree trunk at left frame edge
watch_for: if no front cross shows the tail is behind the standing rope so recross the tail in front
if the loop is smaller than your fist it will be hard to thread later so remake a bigger loop
1.check_yourself: The blue rope forms one open loop with the tail crossing across the standing part.

2.say: Hold the lower blue loop steady with one hand. Pass the blue tail behind the standing rope, then out to the side.
placements: blue rope tail → behind and around blue standing part just above first crossing to exit sideways to the right; in the video: tail sticks out to the right of the standing part with lower loop hanging below center
watch_for: if the tail still points left the tail did not go behind so wrap it fully behind the standing rope
if the upper twist looks loose and open the wrap is too low so slide it up against the crossing
2.check_yourself: The blue rope shows an upper twist with the tail sticking out sideways behind the standing part.

3.say: Push the blue tail down through the lower loop. Pull the blue standing rope and the blue tail to tighten the eight shape.
placements: blue rope tail → down through middle of lower open loop from top to bottom then below knot; in the video: tail exits straight down below tight knot centered in frame

blue standing rope → pulled up above knot to tighten upper loop while tail is pulled down; in the video: standing rope runs straight up from top of knot to top of frame with tree trunk at left and pale wall behind
watch_for: if the shape looks like a single oval instead of an eight the tail missed the lower loop so pull out and rethread through the middle
if one loop is much bigger than the other the knot was tightened unevenly so ease both ends until loops match
3.check_yourself: The blue rope forms a tight figure-eight with two stacked loops and a short tail below.
